single.reason: The single-group quotient is already purely finite (Z2 x Z2), so there is no free-vs-finite mixing in this case.

double.raw_quotient: Z^2 x Z2 x Z2 x Z2 x Z2
double.reason: The double-group quotient contains both a free part and a finite torsion part, so the full Z^2 x Z2^4 should not be called a purely finite indicator group.

bottom_line: 10.4.1.31 single-group is mostly stable. 10.4.1.31 double-group needs a raw-quotient-vs-finite-indicator reinterpretation.
